evidence_set: Diphenhydramine: the 2017 lots were tested only at 150 and 100 mg/mL (positive) and 50 mg/mL (negative), with lower concentrations not tested; the 2021 lots read positive from 25 down to 0.5 mg/mL (lots 018 and 188) or 1 mg/mL (lot 196), but at 50 and 100 mg/mL gave faint control lines and very faint to invisible test lines, called negative by consensus and repeated with the same result (the text gives this for both concentrations without naming lots and separately reports lot 196 at 50 mg/mL as invalid, marked N/A, because strips showed no control line; Fig. 2 also shows lot 018 positive at 100 mg/mL, which the text does not mention), and all three read positive again at 150 mg/mL. The same lots detected fentanyl in water down to 20 ng/mL (2017 lots) and 200 ng/mL (2021 lots). Figure values read by AI reader 146 (second reader) on the full-size image and recorded in the saved text; not re-viewed by the adjudicator.
